mapper.sql: select p.paper_id, p.paper_title, p.subject_id, p.total_score, p.status, p.section_json, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, s.subject_name, (select count(1) from spas_qb_paper_item i where i.paper_id = p.paper_id) as item_count from spas_qb_paper p left join spas_subject s on p.subject_id = s.subject_id
mapper.insert: insert into spas_qb_paper(paper_title, subject_id, total_score, status, section_json, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{paperTitle}, #{subjectId}, #{totalScore}, #{status}'0', #{sectionJson}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from spas_qb_paper where paper_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.paper_id, i.question_id, i.order_num, i.score_value, i.question_no, left(q.content, 80) as content_preview, q.question_type, q.difficulty, (select count(1) from spas_qb_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_id = i.question_id) as knowledge_count from spas_qb_paper_item i left join spas_qb_question q on i.question_id = q.question_id where i.paper_id = #{paperId} order by i.order_num asc, i.item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into spas_qb_paper_item(paper_id, question_id, order_num, score_value, question_no) values(#{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{orderNum}, #{scoreValue}, #{questionNo})

insert into spas_qb_paper_item(paper_id, question_id, order_num, score_value, question_no) values
(#{item.paperId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.orderNum}, #{item.scoreValue}, #{item.questionNo})
mapper.select: select distinct qk.knowledge_id from spas_qb_paper_item i inner join spas_qb_question_knowledge qk on qk.question_id = i.question_id where i.paper_id = #{paperId}
